node.title: Re: Inheritance problem: Not a HASH ref
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
You might be interested in [mod://MooX::InsideOut]: "This is useful for extending non-Moo classes whose internals you don't want to change, or which aren't hash based."

Other than that, there are several other [cpan://InsideOut] classes on CPAN, and in the core there is [doc://Hash::Util::FieldHash], but I've never used the latter so I can't say if it's a good idea to use.
